        int64_t workers_inline1904 = std::max<int64_t>(std::min<int64_t>(LOCAL_T_DYN, 12), 1);

        // Spmd dsl_hc_post: expand_grid
        CoreTaskArgs params_t22;
        params_t22.add_input(hidden_inline1898);
        params_t22.add_input(residual_flat_inline1899);
        params_t22.add_input(post_inline1900);
        params_t22.add_input(mix_flat_inline1901);
        params_t22.add_output(output_flat_inline1902);
        params_t22.launch_spec.set_block_num(workers_inline1904);
        TaskId params_t22_deps[1];
        uint32_t params_t22_deps_count = 0;
        if (ready_inline1903.is_valid()) params_t22_deps[params_t22_deps_count++] = ready_inline1903;
        params_t22.set_dependencies(params_t22_deps, params_t22_deps_count);
        TaskOutputTensors task_22_outs = rt_submit_aiv_task(25, params_t22);
    }
}
